abilities.name: Soulgorgers

abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly non-**^^Unique Hedonites of Slaanesh War Machines^^** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets' melee weapons for the rest of the turn. This ability also affects **Companion** weapons.

abilities.name: Mutilating Blades
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: An Exquisite Trophy
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Hero^^** or **^^Monster^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the phase, the following effects apply:


• This unit's combat attacks that target that enemy unit have **Crit (2 Hits)** and score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.
• If the target is destroyed by this unit's combat attacks this phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by other friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh Daemon^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

abilities.name: Paramount Hunter
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a **^^Charge^^** ability for a **^^Hero^^** within 12" of this unit
abilities.effect: If this unit is not in combat, it can immediately move 2D6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but it must end that move within 1/2" of that **^^Hero^^**. If it does so, this unit has charged, and that **^^Hero^^**'s **^^Charge^^** ability has no effect.

abilities.name: Supernatural Grace
abilities.effect: This unit can use **^^Charge^^** abilities even if it used a **^^Retreat^^** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **^^Retreat^^** abilities.

abilities.name: Refine Senses
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Add 1 to the casting roll if this unit is the target.
abilities.effect: The target has **^^Strike-first^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Soulpiercer** is 4.

abilities.name: The Endless Dance
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:


***The Dance of Dreaming:*** Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target. For the rest of the turn, if the unmodified hit roll for an attack made by that enemy unit that targets this unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.


***The Pavane of Slaanesh:*** This unit can move 2D3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat.


***The Waltz of Lethargy:*** Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target. For the rest of the turn, the target cannot use commands while it is in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Captive Audience
abilities.effect: Enemy units cannot use **^^Retreat^^** abilities while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Shardslash
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by this unit's combat attacks.

abilities.name: Gaze Upon My Magnificence And Weep
abilities.declare: If this unit has not used a **^^Temptation^^** Ability this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to the the target.
abilities.effect:
Your opponent must decide whether the target will **adulate** or **reject** Sigvald.


***Adulate:*** Until the start of your next turn, while the target is in combat with this unit, it tmust pick this unit to be the target of pile-in moves it makes.


***Reject:*** Inflict D3+3 mortal damage on the target, then ***Heal (X)*** this unit, where X is the number of damage points inflicted on the target this turn by this ability.

abilities.name: Paragon Of Vainglory
abilities.effect:
If this unit charged this turn and the unmodified charge roll was 6+ for the rest of the turn:

• Melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, used by other friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh^^** units have **Crit (2 Hits) while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

abilities.name: Joyous Battle Fury
abilities.effect: If any enemy models were slain by this unit's combat attacks this turn, **Heal (D3)** this unit, and add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Impaling Talons** for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

abilities.name: Redolence of Violence
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. If this unit charged this turn, add 2 to the roll. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, 1 model in the target is automatically slain. If the target is a **^^Manifestation^^** and the roll exceeds its banishment value, it is banished and removed from play.

abilities.name: Fleeting Dance of Death
abilities.effect: This unit can use **^^Charge^^** abilities even if it is in combat.

abilities.name: Scion of Slaanesh

The target can be picked to use a **^^Fight^^** ability immediately after the **^^Fight^^** ability used by this unit has been resolved.

abilities.name: Locus of Slaanesh
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Hero Hedonites of Slaanesh Daemon^^** unit that started the battle with 3 or more models and has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Dark Temptations
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following musks. Its effects apply for the rest of the turn.



***Alluring Musk:***
• This unit's weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** for attacks that target that enemy unit.
• Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by that enemy unit that target this unit.


***Psychotropic Musk:***
• Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by that enemy unit that target this unit.

abilities.name: Supernatural Grace
abilities.effect: This unit can use **^^Charge^^** abilities even if it used a **^^Retreat^^** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **^^Retreat^^** abilities.

abilities.declare: Pick any number of visible enemy units within 12" of this unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Subtract 1 from the casting roll for each target you picked after the first.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Elegant Greatblade** is 3.

abilities.name: The Mirror's Depths
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
If the target is within 6" of this unit, the target is **gazing into eternity** until the start of your next turn. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, the target is **gazing into eternity** until the start of your next turn.


While the target is **gazing into eternity**, it must end all moves no further from this unit than it was at the start of the move and it cannot be removed from the battlefield by an ability that would allow it to be set up again on the battlefield.


**Designer's Note:** *This includes pile-in moves.*

abilities.name: Swallow Energy
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a visible **^^Manifestation^^** within 12" of this unit and that was not summoned this turn to be the target, then make a banishment roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:
If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value on the target's warscroll, it is banished and removed from play.


The next time a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses a **^^Summon^^** ability, roll an additional D6, to a maximum of 3, when making the casting roll for that ability.

abilities.name: Champions Of The Gilded Throne
abilities.effect: When players are alternating picking units to use a **^^Fight^^** ability, when it is your turn to pick a unit, instead of picking 1 unit, you can pick a friendly non-**^^Hero Hedonites of Slaanesh Daemon^^** unit wholly within 18" of this unit and a friendly non-**^^Hero Sybarite^^** unit wholly within 18" of this unit. Resolve the second **^^Fight^^** ability immediately after the first.

abilities.name: Unholy Symbiosis
abilities.declare: Pick up to 1 visible friendly **^^Sybarite^^** unit and up to 1 visible friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh Daemon^^** unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: If you picked a **^^Sybarite^^** target, subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by its combat attacks until thte start of your next turn. If you picked a **^^Daemon^^** target, it has Ward (5+) until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Violent Offerings
abilities.effect: If any damage points were allocated this turn by this unit's combat attacks to an enemy **^^Wizard^^**, **^^Priest^^**, **^^Unique^^** unit or unit with an artefact of power, and that enemy unit has been destroyed, add 1 to this unit's power level for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

abilities.name: Truths Of The Twisted Mirror
abilities.declare: If this unit is a **^^Paragon^^**, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of it to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target.

abilities.name: Bargain With The Mist-Daemons
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **^^Spell^^** ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 1, inflict 2 mortal damage on this unit. On a 3+, add 2 to the casting roll.

abilities.name: Mutilating Blades
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Threshing Doom
abilities.effect: When this unit moves, it can pass through models in enemy **^^Infantry^^** units and can pass through the combat ranges of enemy **^^Infantry^^** units, but it cannot end a move in combat unless specified in the ability used.

abilities.name: Veiled Threat
abilities.effect: Set up this unit in reserve **waiting in ambush**. It has now been deployed.

abilities.name: Instinctive Advance
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit within 12" of this unit
abilities.effect: This unit can move 3" immediately after that command has been resolved, unless that command is a reaction, in which case this unit can move after the ability that it was reacting to has been resolved. It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. If this unit was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat with the units it was already in combat with at the start of the move.

abilities.name: Bestial Onslaughted
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if i t is **waiting in ambush**.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Quicksilver Speed
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: If this unit charged this turn and has not used the 'Power Through' command this turn, it can immediately use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

abilities.name: Blissbrew Homonculus
abilities.effect:
This unit's **Blissbrew Homonculi** are tokens. There is 1 **Blissbrew Homonculus** for every 10 models in this unit.


This unit has **Ward (6+)** while it has any **Blissbrew Homonculi**. If you make an unmodified ward roll of 1 for this unit, remove 1 of this unit's **Blissbrew Hoomonculi** from the battlefield (the damage point is still inflicted).

abilities.name: The Thrill Of Combat
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit's ranged weapons have **Shoot in Combat** and they also have **Crit (Auto-wound)** for attacks that target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Arcane Seductor

abilities.name: Crippling Famishment
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:

abilities.effect: You can re-roll the charge roll.

abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this terrain feature to be the target.
abilities.effect:

**Battle Round 1:** 9"
**Battle Round 2:** 12"
**Battle Round 3:** 15"
**Battle Round 4:** 18"
**Battle Round 5:** 21"

abilities.name: Thricefold Court

abilities.effect:
If the target is a **^^Paragon^^**, apply the following effect to the target. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the following effect to the target:

abilities.name: Paragons Of Slaanesh
abilities.declare: If there are fewer than 3 friendly **^^Paragons^^** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh^^** unit that does not have the **^^Paragon^^** keyword and has not had the **^^Paragon^^** keyword this battle to be the target.

abilities.name: Excess Of Agility

***Break their Gaze***: For the rest of the turn, other than the **Companion** ability, weapon abilities for combat attacks made by the target have no effect.

abilities.name: Beguiling Glance
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh Hero^^** unit that has not used a **^^Temptation^^** ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of that **^^Hero^^** to be the target.
abilities.effect:

abilities.name: Chief Of Revels
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Unique Paragon^^** that charged this turn and has not used a **^^Temptation^^** ability this turn to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while that unit using this ability is a **^^Paragon^^**, add 2 to charge rolls for friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of the unit using his ability.

abilities.name: Cutting Barbs
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh Hero^^** that has not use a **^^Temptation^^** ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with that **^^Hero^^** to be the target.
abilities.effect:
If the unit using this ability is a **^^Paragon^^**, pick 1 of the effects below. Otherwise,  your opponent must pick 1 of the effects below.


***Rise to the Insults:*** For the rest of the turn, the target has a maximum control score of 1.


***Turn Aside from the Insults:*** For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the hit rolls for attacks made by friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh^^** units that target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Bashful Visage
abilities.effect: While they are wholly within 6" of this unit, friendly non-**^^Monster^^** non-**^^War Machine Hedonites of Slaanesh^^** units are not visible to enemy units more than 12" from them.

abilities.name: The Rod Of Misrule
abilities.declare: Pick another visible friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, when the target uses the 'Power Through' command, you can pick an enemy target for that command that does not have a lower Health characteristic than the unit using that command.

abilities.name: Crown Of The Ur-Slaanesh
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Hero Infantry Hedonites of Slaanesh^^** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: In Search Of Sin
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh Infantry^^** units to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Each target can move D6". It can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of the move.

abilities.name: Godly Spoor
abilities.effect: While they are wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge, friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh^^** units can use **^^Charge^^** abilities even if they used a **^^Run^^** ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: Sadistic Tendencies
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh^^** unit to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with that unit and that had any damage points allocated to it this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• All of the combat attacks made by that friendly unit must target that enemy unit.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that friendly unit's melee weapons.

abilities.name: Amidst The Phantasmagoria
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh^^** unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by an enemy ability to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield, then set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Agonisingly Elusive
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
If it is your turn, apply the effect below. If it is your opponent's turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below:
Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, this unit must move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Incensed
abilities.declare: Pick an objective within 6" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh^^** units are not visible to enemy units more than 9" from them while all models in those friendly units are contesting the target objective.

abilities.name: Arcane Magnetism
abilities.effect: If this unit has 3 or more damage points, it can use a **^^Spell^^** ability as if it were your hero phase, as if that ability had the **^^Unlimited^^** keyword and as if this unit had **^^Wizard^^** (1).

abilities.name: Unseemly Vitality
abilities.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

abilities.name: Centre Of Attention
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, while this unit is wholly within 12" of the centre of the battlefield and visible to the target:


• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by that enemy unit that target other friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh^^** units.
• Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by other friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh^^** units that target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Dilettante
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Master of Temptation
abilities.declare: You can only use this ability if your opponent has any temptation dice. Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, while your opponent has not used any of their temptation dice to replace a roll for the target this turn, the target can only use **^^Core^^** abilities.

abilities.name: Celebrity Warlord
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Hero Sybarite^^** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: The Need For Perfection
abilities.effect: The first time each turn that an unmodified charge roll, casting roll, unbinding roll or banishment roll for a friendly non-**^^Euphoric^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit is 5 or less, that unit has the **^^Euphoric^^** keyword for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Summon Dreadful Visage
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Dreadful Visage** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a **Dreadful Visage** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Mesmerising Mirror
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Mesmerising Mirror** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a **Mesmerising Mirror** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Summon Wheels of Excruciation
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Wheels of Excruciation** endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a **Wheels of Excruciation** endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Last Ecstasy
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a modoel in the target unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. If the target unit is a **^^Monster^^**, roll 10 dice instead. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **^^Fight^^** ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Overwhelming Acquiescence
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Unit the start of your next turn, weapons used by friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh^^** units for attacks that target that enemy unit, including **Companion** weapons, have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

abilities.name: Hysterical Frenzy
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Obsession with Control
abilities.declare: Pick an objective to be the target.
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the battle, while this unit is contesting the target objective:
• This unit has **^^Ward^^** (5+).
• Add 5 to this unit's control score.

abilities.name: Obsession with Form
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Run' ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Obsession with Pain
abilities.effect: If this unit is damaged, spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent's **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's non-**^^Companion^^** melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
